# edgeos_system_info (Data Source)

Firmware and identity of the router. EdgeOS does not report the exact model over the API, only the hardware platform, which several models share.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "edgeos_system_info" "router" {}

output "firmware" {
  value = "${data.edgeos_system_info.router.version} on ${data.edgeos_system_info.router.models}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `build` (String) Build identifier after the release.
- `domain_name` (String) `system domain-name`, null if not set.
- `host_name` (String) `system host-name`.
- `id` (String) Same as `software_version`.
- `models` (String) Models that use this platform, such as `EdgeRouter X, X SFP, 10X`. Empty for unknown platforms.
- `platform` (String) Hardware platform code, such as `e50`.
- `software_version` (String) Full version string, such as `EdgeRouter.ER-e50.v3.0.1.5800000.250900.1200`.
- `version` (String) Firmware release, such as `v3.0.1`.
